"""Kimi-K3's latent-MoE tail under TP 8 in one FlyDSL launch for gfx950, the ranks' reductions done inside the kernel
over every rank's peer buffer (``runtime``).

256 workgroups of 512 threads, all resident (one a CU), each rank's launch running these hand-offs:

    push      (workgroups 0..199) this rank's routed partial, owner p's 448 latent columns of each row, to p's LRED;
                                 its shared partial, owner p's 896 hidden columns, to p's SRED (reduce-scatters)
    lsum      (workgroup t)      row t of this rank's latent columns: the 8 sources' partials summed in rank order,
                                 rounded to bf16, to every rank's LAG; their sum of squares to every rank's LSQ
    gather    (workgroup t)      row t of the whole latent from LAG, rstd from the 8 owners' sums of squares,
                                 bf16(latent * rstd * norm weight) to the scratch's NBUF, in (word, tag) pairs
    up        (set s's 56)       16 of this rank's hidden columns of the rows of every sets-th 16-row group from s:
                                 its up-projection rows against NBUF's rows by MFMA, each group's operands polled where
                                 they are, plus the 8 sources' shared partials summed in rank order, rounded to bf16
                                 once, to every rank's YAG (an all-gather); plus this rank's own partial alone, rounded
                                 to bf16, into those columns of its shared partial, in place (vLLM's addmm)
    out       (every workgroup)  YAG to the output rows

The up projection runs on one set of 56 workgroups a 16-row group, 4 sets at most (``layout.up_sets``): set 0 is
workgroups 200..255, which push nothing and load their weights at the start; set s > 0 is workgroups 200 - 56 s ..
255 - 56 s, which load theirs once their pushes are out, after their row's gather where they have one. A group's
operand loads are one round of device-scope loads, and a
wave cannot keep a second group's 28 tagged operands in flight beside the first's (2 x 112 VGPRs and the weights' 56,
past the 256 a wave has at 2 waves a SIMD), so the groups go to more workgroups instead of deeper into one.

Every element of the output is computed by one rank and broadcast, so every rank gets the same bits. A hand-off is
one store of (word, tag) pairs, polled until every tag is the launch's: the tag is the workgroup's launch counter plus
one, which the workgroup stores back as it ends, so nothing is zeroed between calls. A wait gives up after the
group's timeout (``runtime.WAIT_SECONDS``), records itself and sets the rank's sticky FAILED word; a wait ends at once
once the group's FAILED word (``runtime.GROUP_FAILED``) is set in its rank's buffer. Either way it sets that word in
every rank's buffer, drained before its wave stores anything more: a rank that reads anything made from a wait that
gave up has its group word set already, which the runtime reads after the rank's step.

From ``layout.FLAG_ROWS`` rows the bulk hand-offs (LRED, SRED, LAG, YAG) go as data then flag instead, the tagged
pairs' half-payload bytes costing more than a round trip: plain bf16 stores (system scope, to the peers' uncached
buffers, regions of their own), s_waitcnt vmcnt(0), then one (1, tag) flag a push job (LRED_F, SRED_F), a row of an
owner (its LSQ pair, as ever) or an up workgroup's token group (YAG_F); the receiver polls the flags, then reads the
payload. The flags carry the launch's tag too, so nothing is zeroed either. A region is written again only by a
launch that could not start before every reader of it in the last launch was done (the out needs every rank's YAG,
which needs every rank's reads of LRED, SRED, LAG and LSQ), so one copy of each is enough.

A lane's MFMA operands of a group are 28 tagged 16-byte loads. The poll loads them all once; a lane that saw a stale
tag then re-loads only its pilot pair (its row's first operand) until that is the launch's, and all of them again.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import functools
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from flydsl._mlir import ir
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import arith, llvm, memref, rocdl, scf, vector
from flydsl.compiler.kernel_function import CompilationContext
from flydsl.expr.gpu import lds_space
from flydsl.utils.smem_allocator import SmemAllocator

from . import kernel_small, runtime

from .layout import (
    FLAG_ROWS,
    GRID,
    HIDDEN,
    HS,
    K_STEPS,
    LATENT,
    LDS_RED,
    LDS_WORDS,
    LS,
    LSUM_LANES,
    MAX_ROWS,
    PEER_END,
    POOL,
    QUADS,
    SCRATCH_END,
    SLICE,
    THREADS,
    TILE,
    TP,
    WAVES,
    accumulator,
    item_lane,
    lag,
    lag_d,
    latent_element,
    latent_job,
    lred,
    lred_d,
    lred_f,
    lsq,
    nbuf,
    out_flag,
    out_items,
    own_element,
    push_job,
    push_jobs,
    set_groups,
    shared_job,
    sred,
    sred_d,
    sred_f,
    up_column,
    up_item,
    up_role,
    up_sets,
    weight_element,
    yag,
    yag_d,
    yag_f,
)

# one build serves every row count: the rows are a launch argument
RANGE_SAFE = True

# gfx950 cache policy bits: SC1 device scope, SC0 | SC1 system scope (the peers), NT streaming
CM_DEV, CM_SYS, CM_NT = 16, 17, 2
TICKS_PER_S = 100_000_000  # s_memrealtime runs at 100 MHz
# A poll reads the group's FAILED word only once it has waited this long: thousands of polling waves loading that one
# word every iteration made it a hot spot that slowed every hand-off (phase marks: 1.5-2 us a hand-off against
# a 0.6 us hop); a failed rank's waits still end within this of the failure
FAIL_CHECK_TICKS = 2_000
# s_sleep of a poll that waits on data far off (the output's all-gather): fewer re-loads of uncached memory while the
# other hand-offs run
FAR_SLEEP = 8
REGIONS = ("lred", "sred", "lag", "lsq", "yag", "nbuf", "lred_f", "sred_f", "yag_f")
# a traced build's marks a workgroup: thread 0's s_memrealtime (low 32 bits) at each, see _Launch.mark
MARKS = 11
_RSRC_FLAGS = (7 << 12) | (4 << 15)  # a raw 32-bit-word buffer, as FlyDSL's make_buffer_ptr on CDNA
assert GRID == runtime.GRID and PEER_END <= runtime.GROUP_FAILED and SCRATCH_END <= runtime.SCRATCH_BYTES
# the kernel's sources, in every build's key: FlyDSL keys the scalars its launcher's closure holds, and the source of
# only the helpers its walk reaches
_SOURCES = hashlib.sha256(
    b"".join(Path(__file__).with_name(name).read_bytes() for name in ("kernel.py", "layout.py"))
).hexdigest()[:16]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- IR pieces


def _i32():
    return ir.IntegerType.get_signless(32)


def _i64():
    return ir.IntegerType.get_signless(64)


def _f32():
    return ir.F32Type.get()


def _vec(n, elem):
    return ir.VectorType.get([n], elem)


def _v(x):
    """The MLIR value of an fx value (or of an MLIR value)."""
    return x if isinstance(x, ir.Value) else fx.as_ir_value(x)


def _const(value, ty):
    return arith.ConstantOp(ty, value).result


def _zero(ty):
    if isinstance(ty, ir.VectorType):
        elem = ty.element_type
        scalar = (
            ir.FloatAttr.get(elem, 0.0) if isinstance(elem, ir.FloatType) else ir.IntegerAttr.get(elem, 0)
        )
        return arith.ConstantOp(ty, ir.DenseElementsAttr.get_splat(ty, scalar)).result
    return _const(0.0 if isinstance(ty, ir.FloatType) else 0, ty)


def _aux(bits):
    return ir.IntegerAttr.get(_i32(), bits)


def _rsrc(base):
    """A buffer resource at the 64-bit address ``base`` (wave-uniform), unbounded."""
    ptr = llvm.IntToPtrOp(ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<1>"), _v(base)).result
    stride = _const(0, ir.IntegerType.get_signless(16))
    return rocdl.make_buffer_rsrc(
        ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<8>"), ptr, stride, _const(0xFFFFFFFF, _i64()), _const(_RSRC_FLAGS, _i32())
    )


def _load(rsrc, offset, words, aux=0):
    """``words`` 32-bit words (1, 2 or 4) at byte ``offset``: an i32, else a vector of them."""
    ty = _i32() if words == 1 else _vec(words, _i32())
    return rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(ty, rsrc, _v(fx.Int32(offset)), _const(0, _i32()), aux=_aux(aux))


def _store(rsrc, offset, value, aux=0):
    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(_v(value), rsrc, _v(fx.Int32(offset)), _const(0, _i32()), aux=_aux(aux))


def _words(values):
    """A vector of i32 words."""
    return vector.from_elements(_vec(len(values), _i32()), [_v(fx.Int32(w)) for w in values])


def _word(vec, i):
    return fx.Int32(vector.extract(vec, [], [i]))


def _f32_of(word):
    return fx.Float32(arith.BitcastOp(_f32(), _v(word)).result)


def _bits(x):
    return fx.Int32(arith.BitcastOp(_i32(), _v(fx.Float32(x))).result)


def _lo(word):
    """The f32 of a bf16 pair word's low half."""
    return _f32_of(fx.Int32(word) << 16)


def _hi(word):
    """The f32 of a bf16 pair word's high half."""
    return _f32_of(fx.Int32(word) & fx.Int32(-65536))


def _pack(a, b):
    """bf16(a) in the low half and bf16(b) in the high half of a word, each rounded to nearest even."""
    pair = vector.from_elements(_vec(2, _f32()), [_v(fx.Float32(a)), _v(fx.Float32(b))])
    bf = arith.TruncFOp(_vec(2, ir.BF16Type.get()), pair).result
    return fx.Int32(vector.extract(vector.bitcast(_vec(1, _i32()), bf), [], [0]))


def _uniform(x):
    """A wave-uniform i32 in a scalar register."""
    return fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(_i32(), _v(fx.Int32(x))))


def _memrealtime():
    return llvm.call_intrinsic(_i64(), "llvm.amdgcn.s.memrealtime", [], [], [])


def _rsq(x):
    return fx.Float32(llvm.call_intrinsic(_f32(), "llvm.amdgcn.rsq.f32", [_v(fx.Float32(x))], [], []))


def _if(cond, then):
    """scf.if without results: ``then()`` emits the guarded ops."""
    op = scf.IfOp(_v(cond), [], has_else=False)
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[0].blocks[0]):
        then()
        scf.YieldOp([])


def _if_else(cond, then, other):
    op = scf.IfOp(_v(cond), [], has_else=True)
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[0].blocks[0]):
        then()
        scf.YieldOp([])
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[1].blocks[0]):
        other()
        scf.YieldOp([])


def _if_values(cond, then, types):
    """``then()``'s values (of ``types``) where ``cond``, else zeros: scf.if with results."""
    op = scf.IfOp(_v(cond), types, has_else=True)
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[0].blocks[0]):
        scf.YieldOp([_v(x) for x in then()])
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[1].blocks[0]):
        scf.YieldOp([_zero(t) for t in types])
    return list(op.results)


def _if_else_values(cond, then, other, types):
    """``then()``'s values (of ``types``) where ``cond``, else ``other()``'s: scf.if with results."""
    op = scf.IfOp(_v(cond), types, has_else=True)
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[0].blocks[0]):
        scf.YieldOp([_v(x) for x in then()])
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[1].blocks[0]):
        scf.YieldOp([_v(x) for x in other()])
    return list(op.results)


def _for(count, body):
    """``body(i)`` for i in 0 .. count - 1 (a runtime count): scf.for without carried values."""
    idx = ir.IndexType.get()
    loop = scf.ForOp(_const(0, idx), arith.IndexCastOp(idx, _v(fx.Int32(count))).result, _const(1, idx))
    with ir.InsertionPoint(loop.body):
        body(fx.Int32(arith.IndexCastOp(_i32(), loop.induction_variable).result))
        scf.YieldOp([])


def _select(cond, a, b):
    return fx.Boolean(cond).select(a, b)


def _wave_sum(x, lane):
    """The f32 sum of x over the wave's 64 lanes, the same bits in every lane (an xor butterfly of commutative
    adds)."""
    x = fx.Float32(x)
    for off in (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1):
        other = rocdl.ds_bpermute(_i32(), _v((lane ^ off) * 4), _v(_bits(x)))
        x = x + _f32_of(other)
    return x


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the mailbox


class _Mailbox:
    """Tagged hand-offs: a payload word next to the launch's tag in one store; a poll re-loads its batch until every
    tag is the launch's, gives up after ``wait_ticks``, and ends at once once the group's FAILED word is set in this
    rank's buffer (``own``). A poll that gave up or ended so sets that word in every rank's buffer (``peers``)."""

    def __init__(self, tag, health, own, peers, bid, wait_ticks):
        self.tag, self.health, self.bid, self.wait_ticks = tag, health, bid, wait_ticks
        self.own, self.peers = own, peers

    def put(self, rsrc, offset, words, aux):
        """``words`` (1 or 2) as (word, tag) pairs from byte ``offset``, in one store."""
        pairs = []
        for w in words:
            pairs += [w, self.tag]
        _store(rsrc, offset, _words(pairs), aux)

    def poll(self, specs, region, sleep=1, pilot=None):
        """The words of every (rsrc, byte offset, words (2 or 4), cache bits) of ``specs`` once each of their tags
        (the odd words) is the launch's: vectors, in order; ``sleep`` the s_sleep between re-loads. With a ``pilot``
        (one more such spec), a lane that saw a stale tag re-loads only the pilot until its tags are the launch's,
        then every spec again."""

        def load_all():
            return [_load(rsrc, offset, words, aux) for rsrc, offset, words, aux in specs]

        t0 = _memrealtime()
        if pilot is None:
            vals, why = self._spin(load_all, self._pending(specs), t0, lambda: rocdl.s_sleep(sleep))
        else:
            rsrc, offset, words, aux = pilot

            def wait_pilot():
                self._spin(lambda: [_load(rsrc, offset, words, aux)], self._pending([pilot]), t0,
                           lambda: rocdl.s_sleep(sleep))  # fmt: skip

            vals, why = self._spin(load_all, self._pending(specs), t0, wait_pilot)
        _if(fx.Int32(why) == 1, lambda: self._give_up(region, specs[0][1], vals[0]))
        _if(fx.Int32(why) != 0, self._fail_group)
        return vals

    def _pending(self, specs):
        """Whether any tag (odd word) of the loaded values of ``specs`` is not the launch's."""

        def pending(vals):
            bad = None
            for (_, _, words, _), val in zip(specs, vals):
                for i in range(1, words, 2):
                    stale = _word(val, i) != self.tag
                    bad = stale if bad is None else bad | stale
            return bad

        return pending

    def _spin(self, load, pending, t0, between):
        """load()'s values, re-loaded (after ``between()``) while pending(values), until the wait (since ``t0``) is
        late or this rank has failed: (values, why), why 0 once loaded, 1 late, 2 failed."""
        init = [*load(), _const(0, _i32())]
        types = [x.type for x in init]
        loop = scf.WhileOp(types, init)
        before = loop.before.blocks.append(*types)
        with ir.InsertionPoint(before):
            args = list(before.arguments)
            scf.ConditionOp(_v(pending(args[:-1]) & (fx.Int32(args[-1]) == 0)), args)
        after = loop.after.blocks.append(*types)
        with ir.InsertionPoint(after):
            between()
            vals = load()
            waited = arith.SubIOp(_memrealtime(), t0).result
            check = arith.CmpIOp(arith.CmpIPredicate.sgt, waited, _const(FAIL_CHECK_TICKS, _i64())).result
            (word,) = _if_values(
                check, lambda: [fx.Int32(_load(self.own, runtime.GROUP_FAILED, 1, CM_SYS))], [_i32()]
            )
            failed = fx.Int32(word) != 0
            late = arith.CmpIOp(arith.CmpIPredicate.sgt, waited, _const(self.wait_ticks, _i64())).result
            why = _select(failed, fx.Int32(2), _select(late, fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)))
            scf.YieldOp([*vals, _v(why)])
        results = list(loop.results)
        return results[:-1], results[-1]

    def _give_up(self, region, offset, seen):
        """This workgroup's record of the wait (flag, region, byte offset, tag, seen tag, workgroup, clock), then
        FAILED, drained after the record."""
        record = (self.bid + 1) * (runtime.RECORD_WORDS * 4)
        clock = fx.Int32(arith.TruncIOp(_i32(), _memrealtime()).result) & 0x7FFFFFFF
        _store(self.health, record, _words([1, runtime.region_id(region), offset, self.tag]), CM_SYS)
        _store(self.health, record + 16, _words([_word(seen, 1), self.bid, clock, 0]), CM_SYS)
        fx.rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
        _store(self.health, runtime.FAILED * 4, _v(fx.Int32(1)), CM_SYS)

    def _fail_group(self):
        """The group's FAILED word set in every rank's buffer, drained: whatever this wave stores after (made from
        stale data) lands after it on every rank."""
        for peer in self.peers:
            _store(peer, runtime.GROUP_FAILED, _v(fx.Int32(1)), CM_SYS)
        fx.rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- stages


class _Launch:
    """One workgroup's view of the launch: ids, the rows, the buffers' resources and the mailbox."""

    def __init__(self, n, rank, eps, ptrs, wait_ticks, lds, trace=None):
        routed, shared, up_w, norm_w, out, peers, scratch, counters, health = ptrs
        self.trace = trace
        self.n, self.rank, self.eps, self.lds = fx.Int32(n), fx.Int32(rank), fx.Float32(eps), lds
        self.tid = fx.Int32(fx.thread_idx.x)
        self.bid = _uniform(fx.block_idx.x)
        self.lane = self.tid % 64
        self.wave = _uniform(self.tid // 64)
        self.routed, self.shared, self.up_w = _rsrc(routed), _rsrc(shared), _rsrc(up_w)
        self.norm_w, self.out, self.scratch = _rsrc(norm_w), _rsrc(out), _rsrc(scratch)
        self.counters, health = _rsrc(counters), _rsrc(health)
        self.tag = _uniform(fx.Int32(_load(self.counters, self.bid * 4, 1, CM_DEV)) + 1)
        table = _rsrc(peers)
        self.bases = [self._base(table, p) for p in range(TP)]
        self.peers = [_rsrc(b) for b in self.bases]
        self.own = _rsrc(self._base(table, self.rank))
        self.mb = _Mailbox(self.tag, health, self.own, self.peers, self.bid, wait_ticks)
        # the bulk hand-offs' protocol, the same in every workgroup of every rank: the rows decide it
        self.flagged = self.n >= FLAG_ROWS

    @staticmethod
    def _base(table, p):
        pair = _load(table, fx.Int32(p) * 8, 2)
        lo = arith.ExtUIOp(_i64(), _v(_uniform(_word(pair, 0)))).result
        hi = arith.ExtUIOp(_i64(), _v(_uniform(_word(pair, 1)))).result
        return arith.OrIOp(arith.ShLIOp(hi, _const(32, _i64())).result, lo).result

    def peer(self, p):
        """Rank p's peer buffer, p wave-uniform."""
        base = self.bases[0]
        for q in range(1, TP):
            base = arith.SelectOp(_v(fx.Int32(p) == q), self.bases[q], base).result
        return _rsrc(base)

    def mark(self, i, when=None):
        """A traced build only: thread 0's clock at mark i, where ``when`` (if given) holds (0 start, 1 pushes (set
        0's weight loads) issued, under the flag protocol their flags stored; a row workgroup's 2 lsum polled, 3 lsq
        and lag polled, 4 NBUF stored; an up workgroup's 5 shared partials polled, 6 first group's operands polled,
        7 MFMAs done, 8 YAG issued (under the flag protocol, its flags stored); 9 out polled, 10 end)."""
        if self.trace is None:
            return
        clock = fx.Int32(arith.TruncIOp(_i32(), _memrealtime()).result)
        cond = self.tid == 0 if when is None else (self.tid == 0) & when
        _if(cond, lambda: _store(self.trace, (self.bid * MARKS + i) * 4, _v(clock), CM_DEV))

    def put_all(self, offset, words):
        """The same pairs to every rank's peer buffer."""
        for p in range(TP):
            self.mb.put(self.peers[p], offset, words, CM_SYS)

    def store_all(self, offset, words):
        """The same plain words (a flag protocol's payload) to every rank's peer buffer."""
        for p in range(TP):
            _store(self.peers[p], offset, _words(words), CM_SYS)

    def protocol(self, plain, tagged, types):
        """``plain()``'s values under the flag protocol, else ``tagged()``'s (both of ``types``)."""
        return _if_else_values(self.flagged, plain, tagged, types)

    def released(self):
        """Flag protocol: the wave's stores so far have completed (s_waitcnt vmcnt(0), a wave's instruction: every
        lane's), so a flag stored after it is seen only after them; across waves, a barrier after it."""
        fx.rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)


def _pushes(c):
    """This wave's push jobs (``layout.push_job``): a (row, owner) job of this rank's routed partial to the owner's
    LRED, or half of one of its shared partial to the owner's SRED; 56 lanes of 8 bf16. Under the flag protocol, a
    job's payload, then its flag once the wave's stores have completed (a wave's second job after its first's flag)."""
    n_latent, n_jobs = push_jobs(c.n)
    for slot in range(2):
        job = push_job(c.bid, c.wave, slot, c.n)

        def one(job=job):
            _if_else(
                job < n_latent,
                lambda: _push(c, c.routed, latent_job(job, c.lane), lred, lred_d, lambda t, col: lred_f(t, c.rank)),
                lambda: _push(c, c.shared, shared_job(job - n_latent, c.lane), sred, sred_d,
                              lambda t, col: sred_f(t, col // LS, c.rank)),  # fmt: skip
            )

        _if(job < n_jobs, one)
    c.mark(1)


def _push(c, src, job, tagged_at, plain_at, flag_at):
    """One job to its owner: at ``tagged_at(this rank, row, column)`` as two (word, tag, word, tag) stores, or at
    ``plain_at(...)`` as one 16-byte store, then (lane 0) the (1, tag) flag at ``flag_at(row, column)``."""
    element, owner, t, col = job

    def tagged():
        def go():
            data = _load(src, element * 2, 4)
            dst, offset = c.peer(owner), tagged_at(c.rank, t, col)
            c.mb.put(dst, offset, [_word(data, 0), _word(data, 1)], CM_SYS)
            c.mb.put(dst, offset + 16, [_word(data, 2), _word(data, 3)], CM_SYS)

        _if(c.lane < SLICE, go)

    def plain():
        _if(c.lane < SLICE, lambda: _store(c.peer(owner), plain_at(c.rank, t, col), _load(src, element * 2, 4), CM_SYS))
        c.released()
        _if(c.lane == 0, lambda: c.mb.put(c.peer(owner), flag_at(t, col), [fx.Int32(1)], CM_SYS))

    _if_else(c.flagged, plain, tagged)


def _rank_sum(pairs):
    """The four bf16 of each source's two words, summed over sources in rank order."""
    acc = None
    for w0, w1 in pairs:
        quad = [_lo(w0), _hi(w0), _lo(w1), _hi(w1)]
        acc = quad if acc is None else [a + x for a, x in zip(acc, quad)]
    return acc


def _payload(vals, tagged):
    """The two payload words of each polled (word, tag, word, tag), or each plain (word, word)."""
    return [(_word(v, 0), _word(v, 2 if tagged else 1)) for v in vals]


def _flat(pairs):
    return [w for pair in pairs for w in pair]


def _paired(words):
    return list(zip(words[0::2], words[1::2]))


def _row(c):
    """Row t = bid: lsum of this rank's latent columns, then the gather of the whole row into NBUF."""
    t = c.bid

    def lsum():
        col = c.tid * 4

        def tagged():
            polled = c.mb.poll([(c.own, lred(src, t, col), 4, CM_SYS) for src in range(TP)], "lred")
            return _flat(_payload(polled, True))

        def plain():
            # the 8 sources' flags of row t (two a 16-byte load), then their payload
            c.mb.poll([(c.own, lred_f(t, 2 * i), 4, CM_SYS) for i in range(TP // 2)], "lred_f")
            return _flat(_payload([_load(c.own, lred_d(src, t, col), 2, CM_SYS) for src in range(TP)], False))

        acc = _rank_sum(_paired(c.protocol(plain, tagged, [_i32()] * (2 * TP))))
        w0, w1 = _pack(acc[0], acc[1]), _pack(acc[2], acc[3])
        _if_else(
            c.flagged,
            lambda: c.store_all(lag_d(t, LS * c.rank + col), [w0, w1]),
            lambda: c.put_all(lag(t, LS * c.rank + col), [w0, w1]),
        )
        rounded = [_lo(w0), _hi(w0), _lo(w1), _hi(w1)]
        ssq = rounded[0] * rounded[0]
        for x in rounded[1:]:
            ssq = fx.Float32(fx.math.fma(x, x, ssq))
        return [ssq]

    (ssq,) = _if_values(c.tid < LSUM_LANES, lsum, [_f32()])
    c.mark(2)
    total = _wave_sum(ssq, c.lane)
    _if((c.lane == 0) & (c.wave < 2), lambda: memref.store(_v(total), c.lds, [_index(LDS_RED + c.wave)]))
    # flag protocol: the row's LSQ pair is the flag of its LAG payload, so every thread's payload first
    _if(c.flagged, c.released)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    _if(
        c.tid == 0,
        lambda: c.put_all(lsq(t, c.rank), [_bits(_load_lds(c, LDS_RED) + _load_lds(c, LDS_RED + 1))]),
    )

    # the gather: quads j0 = tid and j1 = tid + 512 (below 896) of the row
    j0 = c.tid
    has_j1 = c.tid + THREADS < QUADS
    j1 = _select(has_j1, c.tid + THREADS, j0)
    weights = [_load(c.norm_w, 4 * j * 2, 2) for j in (j0, j1)]
    sums_specs = [(c.own, lsq(t, 2 * i), 4, CM_SYS) for i in range(TP // 2)]

    def tagged():
        # the owners' sums of squares and their latent columns in one poll: every owner's lsum puts both at once
        polled = c.mb.poll(sums_specs + [(c.own, lag(t, 4 * j), 4, CM_SYS) for j in (j0, j1)], "lag")
        return polled[: TP // 2] + _flat(_payload(polled[TP // 2 :], True))

    def plain():
        sums = c.mb.poll(sums_specs, "lsq")
        return sums + _flat(_payload([_load(c.own, lag_d(t, 4 * j), 2, CM_SYS) for j in (j0, j1)], False))

    polled = c.protocol(plain, tagged, [_vec(4, _i32())] * (TP // 2) + [_i32()] * 4)
    sums, lat = polled[: TP // 2], _paired(polled[TP // 2 :])
    c.mark(3)
    total = None
    for val in sums:
        for i in (0, 2):
            x = _f32_of(_word(val, i))
            total = x if total is None else total + x
    rstd = _rsq(total * (1.0 / LATENT) + c.eps)

    def normalized(lw, w):
        nw = [_word(w, 0), _word(w, 1)]
        x = [_lo(lw[0]), _hi(lw[0]), _lo(lw[1]), _hi(lw[1])]
        g = [_lo(nw[0]), _hi(nw[0]), _lo(nw[1]), _hi(nw[1])]
        y = [x[e] * rstd * g[e] for e in range(4)]
        return [_pack(y[0], y[1]), _pack(y[2], y[3])]

    # tagged: the up workgroups poll these very pairs, so no flag follows them
    c.mb.put(c.scratch, nbuf(t, 4 * j0), normalized(lat[0], weights[0]), CM_DEV)
    _if(has_j1, lambda: c.mb.put(c.scratch, nbuf(t, 4 * j1), normalized(lat[1], weights[1]), CM_DEV))
    c.mark(4)


def _index(i):
    return arith.IndexCastOp(ir.IndexType.get(), _v(fx.Int32(i))).result


def _load_lds(c, i):
    return fx.Float32(memref.load(c.lds, [_index(i)]))


def _weights(c, j):
    """The A operands of column block j, a lane's 14 x 8 bf16 of its wave's K, in flight together (HBM, streamed)."""
    weights = [_load(c.up_w, weight_element(j, c.wave, c.lane, s) * 2, 4, CM_NT) for s in range(K_STEPS)]
    fx.rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
    return weights


def _up(c, weights, s, j, sets):
    """Set s's workgroup j: this rank's hidden columns 16 j .. 16 j + 15 (rows of its up-projection shard), the rows
    of the set's token groups s, s + sets ..."""
    # item (row t, columns 4 q ..), the set's where its row is: the sources' shared partials summed in rank order
    t, q = up_item(c.tid)
    local = up_column(j, q)
    mine = (t < c.n) & ((t // TILE) % sets == s)

    def shared_sum():
        def tagged():
            polled = c.mb.poll([(c.own, sred(src, t, local), 4, CM_SYS) for src in range(TP)], "sred")
            return _flat(_payload(polled, True))

        def plain():
            # the 8 sources' flags of the half of row t holding the columns, then their payload
            c.mb.poll([(c.own, sred_f(t, local // LS, 2 * i), 4, CM_SYS) for i in range(TP // 2)], "sred_f")
            return _flat(_payload([_load(c.own, sred_d(src, t, local), 2, CM_SYS) for src in range(TP)], False))

        return _rank_sum(_paired(c.protocol(plain, tagged, [_i32()] * (2 * TP))))

    shared = _if_values(mine, shared_sum, [_f32()] * 4)
    c.mark(5)

    def group(i):
        g = s + sets * i
        row = TILE * g + c.lane % TILE
        row = _select(row < c.n, row, c.n - 1)
        # the lane's 8 bf16 of a step are two tagged quads; its pilot is its first step's first pair
        first = [nbuf(0, latent_element(row, c.wave, c.lane, k)) for k in range(K_STEPS)]
        raw = c.mb.poll(
            [(c.scratch, offset + 16 * h, 4, CM_DEV) for offset in first for h in (0, 1)],
            "nbuf",
            pilot=(c.scratch, first[0], 2, CM_DEV),
        )
        c.mark(6, i == 0)
        acc = _zero(_vec(4, _f32()))
        bf8 = _vec(8, ir.BF16Type.get())
        for k in range(K_STEPS):
            lo, hi = raw[2 * k], raw[2 * k + 1]
            b = _words([_word(lo, 0), _word(lo, 2), _word(hi, 0), _word(hi, 2)])
            a_k, b_k = vector.bitcast(bf8, weights[k]), vector.bitcast(bf8, b)
            acc = fx.rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(_vec(4, _f32()), [a_k, b_k, acc])
        vector.store(acc, c.lds, [_index(accumulator(c.wave, g, c.lane))])

    _for(set_groups(s, c.n), group)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    c.mark(7)

    def epilogue():
        lane, g = item_lane(t, q)
        y = None
        for w in range(WAVES):
            acc = vector.load(_vec(4, _f32()), c.lds, [_index(accumulator(w, g, lane))])
            part = [fx.Float32(vector.extract(acc, [], [e])) for e in range(4)]
            y = part if y is None else [a + x for a, x in zip(y, part)]
        v = [fx.Float32(shared[e]) + y[e] for e in range(4)]
        words = [_pack(v[0], v[1]), _pack(v[2], v[3])]
        _if_else(
            c.flagged,
            lambda: c.store_all(yag_d(t, HS * c.rank + local), words),
            lambda: c.put_all(yag(t, HS * c.rank + local), words),
        )
        return y

    y = _if_values(mine, epilogue, [_f32()] * 4)

    def flags():
        # every thread's payload complete, then a flag a token group of the set to every rank, thread i group i's
        c.released()
        fx.gpu.barrier()

        def put():
            for p in range(TP):
                c.mb.put(c.peers[p], yag_f(c.rank, s + sets * c.tid, j), [fx.Int32(1)], CM_SYS)

        _if(c.tid < set_groups(s, c.n), put)

    _if(c.flagged, flags)

    def in_place():
        # as vLLM's addmm: this rank's own partial (its push of these columns, which SRED's poll above saw, has read
        # them) plus the projection, rounded once; after the flags, whose release (s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)) would wait
        # for this store too
        at = own_element(t, c.rank, local) * 2
        own = _load(c.shared, at, 2)
        x = [_lo(_word(own, 0)), _hi(_word(own, 0)), _lo(_word(own, 1)), _hi(_word(own, 1))]
        z = [x[e] + fx.Float32(y[e]) for e in range(4)]
        _store(c.shared, at, _words([_pack(z[0], z[1]), _pack(z[2], z[3])]))

    _if(mine, in_place)
    c.mark(8)


def _out(c):
    """This workgroup's output quads (``layout.out_items``), two a thread at most: YAG to out (under the flag
    protocol, each quad once its owner's up workgroup's flag of its token group is in)."""
    total, per, i0 = out_items(c.bid, c.tid, c.n)
    i1 = i0 + THREADS
    has_i1 = (c.tid + THREADS < per) & (i1 < total)
    i1 = _select(has_i1, i1, i0)

    def tagged():
        polled = c.mb.poll([(c.own, yag(0, 4 * i), 4, CM_SYS) for i in (i0, i1)], "yag", sleep=FAR_SLEEP)
        return _flat(_payload(polled, True))

    def plain():
        c.mb.poll([(c.own, out_flag(i), 2, CM_SYS) for i in (i0, i1)], "yag_f", sleep=FAR_SLEEP)
        return _flat(_payload([_load(c.own, yag_d(0, 4 * i), 2, CM_SYS) for i in (i0, i1)], False))

    def go():
        words = c.protocol(plain, tagged, [_i32()] * 4)
        _store(c.out, 4 * i0 * 2, _words(words[:2]))
        _if(has_i1, lambda: _store(c.out, 4 * i1 * 2, _words(words[2:])))

    _if((c.tid < per) & (i0 < total), go)
    c.mark(9)

@functools.cache
def _make(wait_seconds, traced=False):
    """The launch of one build: its wait timeout (tests shorten it) and whether it records its marks (a tool's
    build, ``run(trace=...)``) are all a build holds."""
    wait_ticks = int(wait_seconds * TICKS_PER_S)
    keyed = (wait_ticks, traced, _SOURCES)
    alloc = SmemAllocator(None, arch="gfx950", global_sym_name="kimi_k3_latent_moe_tail_lds")
    alloc.ptr = LDS_WORDS * 4

    @flyc.kernel
    def k_kimi_k3_latent_moe_tail(
        n: fx.Int32,
        routed: fx.Int64,
        shared: fx.Int64,
        up_w: fx.Int64,
        norm_w: fx.Int64,
        out: fx.Int64,
        peers: fx.Int64,
        scratch: fx.Int64,
        counters: fx.Int64,
        health: fx.Int64,
        rank: fx.Int32,
        eps: fx.Float32,
        trace: fx.Int64,
    ):
        lds_ty = ir.MemRefType.get([LDS_WORDS], _f32(), memory_space=lds_space())
        lds = memref.view(lds_ty, alloc.get_base(), _const(0, ir.IndexType.get()), sizes=[])
        ptrs = (routed, shared, up_w, norm_w, out, peers, scratch, counters, health)
        c = _Launch(n, rank, eps, ptrs, wait_ticks, lds, _rsrc(trace) if traced else None)
        c.mark(0)
        s, j = up_role(c.bid)
        sets = up_sets(c.n)
        up = s < sets
        types = [_vec(4, _i32())] * K_STEPS

        def first():
            # set 0 pushes nothing: its weights' HBM reads overlap every hand-off before its MFMAs
            weights = _weights(c, j)
            c.mark(1)
            return weights

        def pushing():
            _pushes(c)
            return _if_values(up, lambda: _weights(c, j), types)

        weights = _if_else_values(c.bid >= POOL, first, pushing, types)
        _if(c.bid < c.n, lambda: _row(c))
        _if(up, lambda: _up(c, weights, s, j, sets))
        _out(c)
        # the next launch's tag, once every thread of the workgroup has read this one's
        fx.gpu.barrier()
        _if(c.tid == 0, lambda: _store(c.counters, c.bid * 4, _v(c.tag), CM_DEV))
        c.mark(10)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        n: fx.Int32,
        routed: fx.Int64,
        shared: fx.Int64,
        up_w: fx.Int64,
        norm_w: fx.Int64,
        out: fx.Int64,
        peers: fx.Int64,
        scratch: fx.Int64,
        counters: fx.Int64,
        health: fx.Int64,
        rank: fx.Int32,
        eps: fx.Float32,
        trace: fx.Int64,
        stream: fx.Stream,
    ):
        _ = keyed
        alloc.finalized = False
        ctx = CompilationContext.get_current()
        with ir.InsertionPoint(ctx.gpu_module_body):
            alloc.finalize()
        k_kimi_k3_latent_moe_tail(
            n, routed, shared, up_w, norm_w, out, peers, scratch, counters, health, rank, eps, trace
        ).launch(grid=(GRID, 1, 1), block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream)

    return launch


# below this many rows kernel_small.py serves: tagged pairs throughout, no up sets (M = 24: 25.7 us there against
# 28.5 here; M = 32: 30.8 against 28.7; 92 layers in a graph, cold weights, the slowest of 8 MI355X)
SMALL_ROWS = 28


def run(*, routed, shared, up_weight, norm_weight, tp_size, eps, out_dtype, out):
    """out, the same on every rank of the group; every rank calls it with the same row count."""
    if routed.shape[0] < SMALL_ROWS:
        kernel_small.run(routed=routed, shared=shared, up_weight=up_weight, norm_weight=norm_weight,
                         tp_size=tp_size, eps=eps, out_dtype=out_dtype, out=out)  # fmt: skip
        return
    _run(routed, shared, up_weight, norm_weight, tp_size, eps, out)


def _run(routed, shared, up_weight, norm_weight, tp_size, eps, out):
    assert tp_size == TP and 1 <= routed.shape[0] <= MAX_ROWS
    assert routed.shape[1] == LATENT and shared.shape[1] == HIDDEN
    # the group the caller set up (vLLM's route), else one over torch.distributed's default group
    group = runtime.GROUPS.get(routed.device) or runtime.default_group(routed.device.index)
    launch = _make(group.wait_seconds)
    trace_ptr = 0  # an untraced build's
    stream = fx.Stream(torch._C._cuda_getCurrentRawStream(routed.device.index))
    state = (
        group.peer_table.data_ptr(),
        group.scratch.data_ptr(),
        group.counters.data_ptr(),
        group.health.data_ptr(),
    )
    ptrs = (
        routed.data_ptr(),
        shared.data_ptr(),
        up_weight.data_ptr(),
        norm_weight.data_ptr(),
        out.data_ptr(),
    )
    if launch not in group.warmed:
        # the build's first launch compiles it: an empty one (no row, no wait) on every rank, then every rank past it,
        # so that no rank's first real launch waits on another's compile
        launch(0, *ptrs, *state, group.rank, 1.0, trace_ptr, stream)
        group.warmed.add(launch)
        runtime.every_rank_compiled(group, launch)
    launch(routed.shape[0], *ptrs, *state, group.rank, float(eps), trace_ptr, stream)

"""The tail below ``kernel.SMALL_ROWS`` rows (``kernel.run`` hands those calls here): every hand-off a tagged pair,
the gather's NBUF then its row's NRDY flag, the up projection on workgroups 0 .. 55 alone. Fewer hand-offs and no
flags beat the large-row kernel's spread at a few rows.
The rest as the large-row kernel's first version: Kimi-K3's latent-MoE tail under TP 8 in one FlyDSL launch for gfx950, the ranks' reductions done inside the kernel
over every rank's peer buffer (``runtime``).

256 workgroups of 512 threads, all resident (one a CU), each rank's launch running these hand-offs:

    push      (workgroups 56 ..)  this rank's routed partial, owner p's 448 latent columns of each row, to p's LRED;
                                 its shared partial, owner p's 896 hidden columns, to p's SRED (reduce-scatters)
    lsum      (workgroup 56 + t) row t of this rank's latent columns: the 8 sources' partials summed in rank order,
                                 rounded to bf16, to every rank's LAG; their sum of squares to every rank's LSQ
    gather    (workgroup 56 + t) row t of the whole latent from LAG, rstd from the 8 owners' sums of squares,
                                 bf16(latent * rstd * norm weight) to the scratch's NBUF, then the row's NRDY flag
    up        (workgroups 0..55) 16 of this rank's hidden columns: its up-projection rows (loaded at the start)
                                 against NBUF's rows by MFMA, plus the 8 sources' shared partials summed in rank order,
                                 rounded to bf16 once, to every rank's YAG (an all-gather); plus this rank's own
                                 partial alone, rounded to bf16, into those columns of its shared partial, in place
                                 (vLLM's addmm)
    out       (every workgroup)  YAG to the output rows

Every element of the output is computed by one rank and broadcast, so every rank gets the same bits. A hand-off is
one store of (word, tag) pairs, polled until every tag is the launch's: the tag is the workgroup's launch counter plus
one, which the workgroup stores back as it ends, so nothing is zeroed between calls. A wait gives up after the
group's timeout (``runtime.WAIT_SECONDS``), records itself and sets the rank's sticky FAILED word; a wait ends at once
once the group's FAILED word (``runtime.GROUP_FAILED``) is set in its rank's buffer. Either way it sets that word in
every rank's buffer, drained before its wave stores anything more: a rank that reads anything made from a wait that
gave up has its group word set already, which the runtime reads after the rank's step.
"""

# word every iteration made it a hot spot that slowed every hand-off (phase marks: 1.5-2 us a hand-off against

# only the helpers its walk reaches
_SOURCES = hashlib.sha256(
    b"".join(Path(__file__).with_name(name).read_bytes() for name in ("kernel_small.py", "layout_small.py"))
).hexdigest()[:16]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- IR pieces


def _i32():
    return ir.IntegerType.get_signless(32)


def _i64():
    return ir.IntegerType.get_signless(64)


def _f32():
    return ir.F32Type.get()


def _vec(n, elem):
    return ir.VectorType.get([n], elem)


def _v(x):
    """The MLIR value of an fx value (or of an MLIR value)."""
    return x if isinstance(x, ir.Value) else fx.as_ir_value(x)


def _const(value, ty):
    return arith.ConstantOp(ty, value).result


def _zero(ty):
    if isinstance(ty, ir.VectorType):
        elem = ty.element_type
        scalar = (
            ir.FloatAttr.get(elem, 0.0) if isinstance(elem, ir.FloatType) else ir.IntegerAttr.get(elem, 0)
        )
        return arith.ConstantOp(ty, ir.DenseElementsAttr.get_splat(ty, scalar)).result
    return _const(0.0 if isinstance(ty, ir.FloatType) else 0, ty)


def _aux(bits):
    return ir.IntegerAttr.get(_i32(), bits)


def _rsrc(base):
    """A buffer resource at the 64-bit address ``base`` (wave-uniform), unbounded."""
    ptr = llvm.IntToPtrOp(ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<1>"), _v(base)).result
    stride = _const(0, ir.IntegerType.get_signless(16))
    return rocdl.make_buffer_rsrc(
        ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<8>"), ptr, stride, _const(0xFFFFFFFF, _i64()), _const(_RSRC_FLAGS, _i32())
    )


def _load(rsrc, offset, words, aux=0):
    """``words`` 32-bit words (1, 2 or 4) at byte ``offset``: an i32, else a vector of them."""
    ty = _i32() if words == 1 else _vec(words, _i32())
    return rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(ty, rsrc, _v(fx.Int32(offset)), _const(0, _i32()), aux=_aux(aux))


def _store(rsrc, offset, value, aux=0):
    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(_v(value), rsrc, _v(fx.Int32(offset)), _const(0, _i32()), aux=_aux(aux))


def _words(values):
    """A vector of i32 words."""
    return vector.from_elements(_vec(len(values), _i32()), [_v(fx.Int32(w)) for w in values])


def _word(vec, i):
    return fx.Int32(vector.extract(vec, [], [i]))


def _f32_of(word):
    return fx.Float32(arith.BitcastOp(_f32(), _v(word)).result)


def _bits(x):
    return fx.Int32(arith.BitcastOp(_i32(), _v(fx.Float32(x))).result)


def _lo(word):
    """The f32 of a bf16 pair word's low half."""
    return _f32_of(fx.Int32(word) << 16)


def _hi(word):
    """The f32 of a bf16 pair word's high half."""
    return _f32_of(fx.Int32(word) & fx.Int32(-65536))


def _pack(a, b):
    """bf16(a) in the low half and bf16(b) in the high half of a word, each rounded to nearest even."""
    pair = vector.from_elements(_vec(2, _f32()), [_v(fx.Float32(a)), _v(fx.Float32(b))])
    bf = arith.TruncFOp(_vec(2, ir.BF16Type.get()), pair).result
    return fx.Int32(vector.extract(vector.bitcast(_vec(1, _i32()), bf), [], [0]))


def _uniform(x):
    """A wave-uniform i32 in a scalar register."""
    return fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(_i32(), _v(fx.Int32(x))))


def _memrealtime():
    return llvm.call_intrinsic(_i64(), "llvm.amdgcn.s.memrealtime", [], [], [])


def _rsq(x):
    return fx.Float32(llvm.call_intrinsic(_f32(), "llvm.amdgcn.rsq.f32", [_v(fx.Float32(x))], [], []))


def _if(cond, then):
    """scf.if without results: ``then()`` emits the guarded ops."""
    op = scf.IfOp(_v(cond), [], has_else=False)
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[0].blocks[0]):
        then()
        scf.YieldOp([])


def _if_else(cond, then, other):
    op = scf.IfOp(_v(cond), [], has_else=True)
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[0].blocks[0]):
        then()
        scf.YieldOp([])
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[1].blocks[0]):
        other()
        scf.YieldOp([])


def _if_values(cond, then, types):
    """``then()``'s values (of ``types``) where ``cond``, else zeros: scf.if with results."""
    op = scf.IfOp(_v(cond), types, has_else=True)
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[0].blocks[0]):
        scf.YieldOp([_v(x) for x in then()])
    with ir.InsertionPoint(op.regions[1].blocks[0]):
        scf.YieldOp([_zero(t) for t in types])
    return list(op.results)


def _for(count, body):
    """``body(i)`` for i in 0 .. count - 1 (a runtime count): scf.for without carried values."""
    idx = ir.IndexType.get()
    loop = scf.ForOp(_const(0, idx), arith.IndexCastOp(idx, _v(fx.Int32(count))).result, _const(1, idx))
    with ir.InsertionPoint(loop.body):
        body(fx.Int32(arith.IndexCastOp(_i32(), loop.induction_variable).result))
        scf.YieldOp([])


def _select(cond, a, b):
    return fx.Boolean(cond).select(a, b)


def _wave_sum(x, lane):
    """The f32 sum of x over the wave's 64 lanes, the same bits in every lane (an xor butterfly of commutative
    adds)."""
    x = fx.Float32(x)
    for off in (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1):
        other = rocdl.ds_bpermute(_i32(), _v((lane ^ off) * 4), _v(_bits(x)))
        x = x + _f32_of(other)
    return x


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the mailbox


class _Mailbox:
    """Tagged hand-offs: a payload word next to the launch's tag in one store; a poll re-loads its batch until every
    tag is the launch's, gives up after ``wait_ticks``, and ends at once once the group's FAILED word is set in this
    rank's buffer (``own``). A poll that gave up or ended so sets that word in every rank's buffer (``peers``)."""

    def __init__(self, tag, health, own, peers, bid, wait_ticks):
        self.tag, self.health, self.bid, self.wait_ticks = tag, health, bid, wait_ticks
        self.own, self.peers = own, peers

    def put(self, rsrc, offset, words, aux):
        """``words`` (1 or 2) as (word, tag) pairs from byte ``offset``, in one store."""
        pairs = []
        for w in words:
            pairs += [w, self.tag]
        _store(rsrc, offset, _words(pairs), aux)

    def poll(self, specs, region, sleep=1):
        """The words of every (rsrc, byte offset, words (2 or 4), cache bits) of ``specs`` once each of their tags
        (the odd words) is the launch's: vectors, in order; ``sleep`` the s_sleep between re-loads."""
        tag = self.tag

        def load_all():
            return [_load(rsrc, offset, words, aux) for rsrc, offset, words, aux in specs]

        def pending(vals):
            bad = None
            for (_, _, words, _), val in zip(specs, vals):
                for i in range(1, words, 2):
                    stale = _word(val, i) != tag
                    bad = stale if bad is None else bad | stale
            return bad

        t0 = _memrealtime()
        init = [*load_all(), _const(0, _i32())]
        types = [x.type for x in init]
        loop = scf.WhileOp(types, init)
        before = loop.before.blocks.append(*types)
        with ir.InsertionPoint(before):
            args = list(before.arguments)
            scf.ConditionOp(_v(pending(args[:-1]) & (fx.Int32(args[-1]) == 0)), args)
        after = loop.after.blocks.append(*types)
        with ir.InsertionPoint(after):
            rocdl.s_sleep(sleep)
            vals = load_all()
            waited = arith.SubIOp(_memrealtime(), t0).result
            check = arith.CmpIOp(arith.CmpIPredicate.sgt, waited, _const(FAIL_CHECK_TICKS, _i64())).result
            (word,) = _if_values(
                check, lambda: [fx.Int32(_load(self.own, runtime.GROUP_FAILED, 1, CM_SYS))], [_i32()]
            )
            failed = fx.Int32(word) != 0
            late = arith.CmpIOp(arith.CmpIPredicate.sgt, waited, _const(self.wait_ticks, _i64())).result
            why = _select(failed, fx.Int32(2), _select(late, fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)))
            scf.YieldOp([*vals, _v(why)])
        results = list(loop.results)
        _if(fx.Int32(results[-1]) == 1, lambda: self._give_up(region, specs[0][1], results[0]))
        _if(fx.Int32(results[-1]) != 0, self._fail_group)
        return results[:-1]

    def _give_up(self, region, offset, seen):
        """This workgroup's record of the wait (flag, region, byte offset, tag, seen tag, workgroup, clock), then
        FAILED, drained after the record."""
        record = (self.bid + 1) * (runtime.RECORD_WORDS * 4)
        clock = fx.Int32(arith.TruncIOp(_i32(), _memrealtime()).result) & 0x7FFFFFFF
        _store(self.health, record, _words([1, runtime.region_id(region), offset, self.tag]), CM_SYS)
        _store(self.health, record + 16, _words([_word(seen, 1), self.bid, clock, 0]), CM_SYS)
        fx.rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
        _store(self.health, runtime.FAILED * 4, _v(fx.Int32(1)), CM_SYS)

    def _fail_group(self):
        """The group's FAILED word set in every rank's buffer, drained: whatever this wave stores after (made from
        stale data) lands after it on every rank."""
        for peer in self.peers:
            _store(peer, runtime.GROUP_FAILED, _v(fx.Int32(1)), CM_SYS)
        fx.rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- stages


class _Launch:
    """One workgroup's view of the launch: ids, the rows, the buffers' resources and the mailbox."""

    def __init__(self, n, rank, eps, ptrs, wait_ticks, lds, trace=None):
        routed, shared, up_w, norm_w, out, peers, scratch, counters, health = ptrs
        self.trace = trace
        self.n, self.rank, self.eps, self.lds = fx.Int32(n), fx.Int32(rank), fx.Float32(eps), lds
        self.tid = fx.Int32(fx.thread_idx.x)
        self.bid = _uniform(fx.block_idx.x)
        self.lane = self.tid % 64
        self.wave = _uniform(self.tid // 64)
        self.routed, self.shared, self.up_w = _rsrc(routed), _rsrc(shared), _rsrc(up_w)
        self.norm_w, self.out, self.scratch = _rsrc(norm_w), _rsrc(out), _rsrc(scratch)
        self.counters, health = _rsrc(counters), _rsrc(health)
        self.tag = _uniform(fx.Int32(_load(self.counters, self.bid * 4, 1, CM_DEV)) + 1)
        table = _rsrc(peers)
        self.bases = [self._base(table, p) for p in range(TP)]
        self.peers = [_rsrc(b) for b in self.bases]
        self.own = _rsrc(self._base(table, self.rank))
        self.mb = _Mailbox(self.tag, health, self.own, self.peers, self.bid, wait_ticks)

    @staticmethod
    def _base(table, p):
        pair = _load(table, fx.Int32(p) * 8, 2)
        lo = arith.ExtUIOp(_i64(), _v(_uniform(_word(pair, 0)))).result
        hi = arith.ExtUIOp(_i64(), _v(_uniform(_word(pair, 1)))).result
        return arith.OrIOp(arith.ShLIOp(hi, _const(32, _i64())).result, lo).result

    def peer(self, p):
        """Rank p's peer buffer, p wave-uniform."""
        base = self.bases[0]
        for q in range(1, TP):
            base = arith.SelectOp(_v(fx.Int32(p) == q), self.bases[q], base).result
        return _rsrc(base)

    def mark(self, i):
        """A traced build only: thread 0's clock at mark i (0 start, 1 pushes (an up workgroup's weight loads)
        issued; a row workgroup's 2 lsum, 3 lsq and lag polled, 4 rstd, 5 NRDY stored; an up workgroup's 2 inputs
        ready, 3 MFMAs done, 4 YAG issued; 6 out polled, 7 end)."""
        if self.trace is None:
            return
        clock = fx.Int32(arith.TruncIOp(_i32(), _memrealtime()).result)
        _if(self.tid == 0, lambda: _store(self.trace, (self.bid * MARKS + i) * 4, _v(clock), CM_DEV))

    def put_all(self, offset, words):
        """The same pairs to every rank's peer buffer."""
        for p in range(TP):
            self.mb.put(self.peers[p], offset, words, CM_SYS)


def _pushes(c):
    """This wave's push jobs (``layout.push_job``): a (row, owner) job of this rank's routed partial to the owner's
    LRED, or half of one of its shared partial to the owner's SRED; 56 lanes of 8 bf16."""
    n_latent, n_jobs = push_jobs(c.n)
    for slot in range(2):
        job = push_job(c.bid, c.wave, slot, c.n)

        def one(job=job):
            _if_else(
                job < n_latent,
                lambda: _push(c, c.routed, latent_job(job, c.lane, c.rank)),
                lambda: _push(c, c.shared, shared_job(job - n_latent, c.lane, c.rank)),
            )

        _if(job < n_jobs, one)
    c.mark(1)


def _push(c, src, job):
    element, owner, offset = job

    def go():
        data = _load(src, element * 2, 4)
        dst = c.peer(owner)
        c.mb.put(dst, offset, [_word(data, 0), _word(data, 1)], CM_SYS)
        c.mb.put(dst, offset + 16, [_word(data, 2), _word(data, 3)], CM_SYS)

    _if(c.lane < SLICE, go)


def _rank_sum(vals):
    """The four bf16 of each source's quad (a polled (word, tag, word, tag)), summed over sources in rank order."""
    acc = None
    for val in vals:
        quad = [_lo(_word(val, 0)), _hi(_word(val, 0)), _lo(_word(val, 2)), _hi(_word(val, 2))]
        acc = quad if acc is None else [a + x for a, x in zip(acc, quad)]
    return acc


def _row(c):
    """Row t = bid - 56: lsum of this rank's latent columns, then the gather of the whole row into NBUF."""
    t = c.bid - ROW0

    def lsum():
        col = c.tid * 4
        acc = _rank_sum(c.mb.poll([(c.own, lred(src, t, col), 4, CM_SYS) for src in range(TP)], "lred"))
        w0, w1 = _pack(acc[0], acc[1]), _pack(acc[2], acc[3])
        c.put_all(lag(t, LS * c.rank + col), [w0, w1])
        rounded = [_lo(w0), _hi(w0), _lo(w1), _hi(w1)]
        ssq = rounded[0] * rounded[0]
        for x in rounded[1:]:
            ssq = fx.Float32(fx.math.fma(x, x, ssq))
        return [ssq]

    (ssq,) = _if_values(c.tid < LSUM_LANES, lsum, [_f32()])
    c.mark(2)
    total = _wave_sum(ssq, c.lane)
    _if((c.lane == 0) & (c.wave < 2), lambda: memref.store(_v(total), c.lds, [_index(LDS_RED + c.wave)]))
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    _if(
        c.tid == 0,
        lambda: c.put_all(lsq(t, c.rank), [_bits(_load_lds(c, LDS_RED) + _load_lds(c, LDS_RED + 1))]),
    )

    # the gather: quads j0 = tid and j1 = tid + 512 (below 896) of the row
    j0 = c.tid
    has_j1 = c.tid + THREADS < QUADS
    j1 = _select(has_j1, c.tid + THREADS, j0)
    weights = [_load(c.norm_w, 4 * j * 2, 2) for j in (j0, j1)]
    # the owners' sums of squares and their latent columns in one poll: every owner's lsum puts both at once
    polled = c.mb.poll(
        [(c.own, lsq(t, 2 * i), 4, CM_SYS) for i in range(TP // 2)]
        + [(c.own, lag(t, 4 * j), 4, CM_SYS) for j in (j0, j1)],
        "lag",
    )
    sums, lat = polled[: TP // 2], polled[TP // 2 :]
    c.mark(3)
    total = None
    for val in sums:
        for i in (0, 2):
            x = _f32_of(_word(val, i))
            total = x if total is None else total + x
    rstd = _rsq(total * (1.0 / LATENT) + c.eps)
    c.mark(4)

    def normalized(val, w):
        lw, nw = [_word(val, 0), _word(val, 2)], [_word(w, 0), _word(w, 1)]
        x = [_lo(lw[0]), _hi(lw[0]), _lo(lw[1]), _hi(lw[1])]
        g = [_lo(nw[0]), _hi(nw[0]), _lo(nw[1]), _hi(nw[1])]
        y = [x[e] * rstd * g[e] for e in range(4)]
        return _words([_pack(y[0], y[1]), _pack(y[2], y[3])])

    _store(c.scratch, nbuf(t, 4 * j0), normalized(lat[0], weights[0]), CM_DEV)
    _if(has_j1, lambda: _store(c.scratch, nbuf(t, 4 * j1), normalized(lat[1], weights[1]), CM_DEV))
    # NRDY once every thread's NBUF stores have landed
    fx.rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    _if(c.tid == 0, lambda: c.mb.put(c.scratch, nrdy(t), [fx.Int32(1)], CM_DEV))
    c.mark(5)


def _index(i):
    return arith.IndexCastOp(ir.IndexType.get(), _v(fx.Int32(i))).result


def _load_lds(c, i):
    return fx.Float32(memref.load(c.lds, [_index(i)]))


def _up(c):
    """Workgroup j: this rank's hidden columns 16 j .. 16 j + 15 (rows of its up-projection shard), every row."""
    j = c.bid
    # the A operands first: the up workgroups push nothing (layout.push_job), so these HBM reads overlap every hand-off
    # before the MFMAs
    weights = [_load(c.up_w, weight_element(j, c.wave, c.lane, s) * 2, 4, CM_NT) for s in range(K_STEPS)]
    fx.rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
    c.mark(1)
    # item (row t, columns 4 q ..): the sources' shared partials summed in rank order, and this rank's own (two
    # words), which the epilogue writes back in place
    t, q = up_item(c.tid)
    local = up_column(j, q)

    def shared_sum():
        vals = c.mb.poll([(c.own, sred(src, t, local), 4, CM_SYS) for src in range(TP)], "sred")
        own = [_word(vals[0], 0), _word(vals[0], 2)]
        for src in range(1, TP):
            own = [_select(c.rank == src, _word(vals[src], 2 * i), own[i]) for i in (0, 1)]
        return [*_rank_sum(vals), *own]

    summed = _if_values(t < c.n, shared_sum, [_f32()] * 4 + [_i32()] * 2)
    shared, own = summed[:4], summed[4:]
    _if(c.tid < c.n, lambda: c.mb.poll([(c.scratch, nrdy(c.tid), 2, CM_DEV)], "nrdy"))
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    c.mark(2)

    def group(g):
        row = TILE * g + c.lane % TILE
        row = _select(row < c.n, row, c.n - 1)
        b = [
            _load(c.scratch, nbuf(0, latent_element(row, c.wave, c.lane, s)), 4, CM_DEV)
            for s in range(K_STEPS)
        ]
        # every operand in flight before the first MFMA waits (LLVM would interleave them to save registers)
        fx.rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
        acc = _zero(_vec(4, _f32()))
        bf8 = _vec(8, ir.BF16Type.get())
        for s in range(K_STEPS):
            a_s, b_s = vector.bitcast(bf8, weights[s]), vector.bitcast(bf8, b[s])
            acc = fx.rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(_vec(4, _f32()), [a_s, b_s, acc])
        vector.store(acc, c.lds, [_index(accumulator(c.wave, g, c.lane))])

    _for((c.n + TILE - 1) // TILE, group)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    c.mark(3)

    def epilogue():
        lane, g = item_lane(t, q)
        y = None
        for w in range(WAVES):
            acc = vector.load(_vec(4, _f32()), c.lds, [_index(accumulator(w, g, lane))])
            part = [fx.Float32(vector.extract(acc, [], [e])) for e in range(4)]
            y = part if y is None else [a + x for a, x in zip(y, part)]
        v = [fx.Float32(shared[e]) + y[e] for e in range(4)]
        c.put_all(yag(t, HS * c.rank + local), [_pack(v[0], v[1]), _pack(v[2], v[3])])
        # in place, as vLLM's addmm: this rank's own partial plus the projection, rounded once (its push of these
        # columns, which SRED's poll above saw, has read them)
        o = [_lo(own[0]), _hi(own[0]), _lo(own[1]), _hi(own[1])]
        mine = [_pack(o[0] + y[0], o[1] + y[1]), _pack(o[2] + y[2], o[3] + y[3])]
        _store(c.shared, own_element(t, c.rank, local) * 2, _words(mine))

    _if(t < c.n, epilogue)
    c.mark(4)


def _out(c):
    """This workgroup's output quads (``layout.out_items``), two a thread at most: YAG to out."""
    total, per, i0 = out_items(c.bid, c.tid, c.n)
    i1 = i0 + THREADS
    has_i1 = (c.tid + THREADS < per) & (i1 < total)
    i1 = _select(has_i1, i1, i0)

    def go():
        vals = c.mb.poll([(c.own, yag(0, 4 * i), 4, CM_SYS) for i in (i0, i1)], "yag", sleep=FAR_SLEEP)
        _store(c.out, 4 * i0 * 2, _words([_word(vals[0], 0), _word(vals[0], 2)]))
        _if(has_i1, lambda: _store(c.out, 4 * i1 * 2, _words([_word(vals[1], 0), _word(vals[1], 2)])))

    _if((c.tid < per) & (i0 < total), go)
    c.mark(6)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- build and launch


@functools.cache
def _make(wait_seconds, traced=False):
    """The launch of one build: its wait timeout (tests shorten it) and whether it records its marks (a tool's
    build, ``run(trace=...)``) are all a build holds."""
    wait_ticks = int(wait_seconds * TICKS_PER_S)
    keyed = (wait_ticks, traced, _SOURCES)
    alloc = SmemAllocator(None, arch="gfx950", global_sym_name="kimi_k3_latent_moe_tail_small_lds")
    alloc.ptr = LDS_WORDS * 4

    @flyc.kernel
    def k_kimi_k3_latent_moe_tail_small(
        n: fx.Int32,
        routed: fx.Int64,
        shared: fx.Int64,
        up_w: fx.Int64,
        norm_w: fx.Int64,
        out: fx.Int64,
        peers: fx.Int64,
        scratch: fx.Int64,
        counters: fx.Int64,
        health: fx.Int64,
        rank: fx.Int32,
        eps: fx.Float32,
        trace: fx.Int64,
    ):
        lds_ty = ir.MemRefType.get([LDS_WORDS], _f32(), memory_space=lds_space())
        lds = memref.view(lds_ty, alloc.get_base(), _const(0, ir.IndexType.get()), sizes=[])
        ptrs = (routed, shared, up_w, norm_w, out, peers, scratch, counters, health)
        c = _Launch(n, rank, eps, ptrs, wait_ticks, lds, _rsrc(trace) if traced else None)
        c.mark(0)

        def other():
            _pushes(c)
            _if(c.bid - ROW0 < c.n, lambda: _row(c))

        _if_else(c.bid < UP_CTAS, lambda: _up(c), other)
        _out(c)
        # the next launch's tag, once every thread of the workgroup has read this one's
        fx.gpu.barrier()
        _if(c.tid == 0, lambda: _store(c.counters, c.bid * 4, _v(c.tag), CM_DEV))
        c.mark(7)

LSUM_LANES = LS // 4  # 112: a bf16 quad a thread

"""What the latent-MoE tail kernel keeps per rank between calls: an uncached buffer every rank of the group has
mapped (``peer_table``, the ranks' base addresses) with the group's FAILED word at its end, a device scratch, one
launch counter per workgroup and the health words.

Every launch of the kernel reads its workgroup's counter as its mailbox tag and bumps it as it ends, so every rank's
counters advance together as long as every rank launches the kernel the same number of times: the caller declines
alike on every rank, and nothing here is ever zeroed between calls.

A rank whose in-kernel wait gives up (``WAIT_SECONDS``) records the wait in its health words, sets its FAILED word,
and sets the group's (``GROUP_FAILED``) in every rank's buffer before it stores anything more; a wait that ends
because the group's word is set (they all do, soon: so no rank hangs) sets it on every rank the same way. Both are
sticky. So whatever data any rank reads from a wait that gave up, its own group word was set first: a rank's group
word (``TailGroup.failed_word``), read after its step's launches, says whether its step saw one.

The group is set up collectively, once a device: by the caller over its group (vLLM's route, over vLLM's TP group,
through ``setup`` before its first call), else by the kernel's first call over torch.distributed's default group
(``default_group``)."""

def tp_agree(ok: bool, group: Any) -> bool:
    """True when every rank of ``group`` (a CPU process group, or None for one rank) passed ``ok``; every rank must

    if group is None:

class Hip:

    _lib = None

    class Handle(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("reserved", ctypes.c_byte * 64)]

    @classmethod
    def lib(cls):
        if cls._lib is None:
            for name in ("libamdhip64.so.7", "libamdhip64.so.6", "libamdhip64.so"):

            void_p, uint = ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint

                ("hipMemcpyAsync", [void_p, void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_int, void_p]),
                ("hipDeviceSynchronize", []),

                ("hipIpcOpenMemHandle", [ctypes.POINTER(void_p), cls.Handle, uint]),
                ("hipIpcCloseMemHandle", [void_p]),
                ("hipFree", [void_p]),

        return torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).multi_processor_count

    @classmethod
    def alloc_uncached(cls, nbytes: int) -> int:
        """Zeroed uncached device memory on the current device, whole pages (IPC handles of uncached memory need
        them); the zeros land before a peer can map it."""
        lib, ptr = cls.lib(), ctypes.c_void_p()
        nbytes = -(-nbytes // 4096) * 4096
        cls.check(lib.hipExtMallocWithFlags(ctypes.byref(ptr), nbytes, cls.UNCACHED), "hipExtMallocWithFlags")
        cls.check(lib.hipMemset(ptr, 0, nbytes), "hipMemset")
        cls.check(lib.hipDeviceSynchronize(), "hipDeviceSynchronize")
        return int(ptr.value)

    @classmethod
    def copy_word(cls, host: torch.Tensor, address: int, stream: int) -> None:
        """The int32 at device ``address`` into ``host`` (one pinned int32), queued on ``stream``."""
        lib, d2h = cls.lib(), 2  # hipMemcpyDeviceToHost
        err = lib.hipMemcpyAsync(ctypes.c_void_p(host.data_ptr()), ctypes.c_void_p(address), 4, d2h,
                                 ctypes.c_void_p(stream))  # fmt: skip
        cls.check(err, "hipMemcpyAsync")

    @classmethod
    def handle(cls, ptr: int) -> bytes:
        h = cls.Handle()
        cls.check(cls.lib().hipIpcGetMemHandle(ctypes.byref(h), ctypes.c_void_p(ptr)), "hipIpcGetMemHandle")
        return bytes(h.reserved)

    @classmethod
    def open(cls, handle: bytes) -> int:
        h, ptr = cls.Handle(), ctypes.c_void_p()
        ctypes.memmove(ctypes.byref(h), handle, cls.HANDLE_BYTES)
        cls.check(
            cls.lib().hipIpcOpenMemHandle(ctypes.byref(ptr), h, cls.LAZY_PEER_ACCESS), "hipIpcOpenMemHandle"
        )
        return int(ptr.value)

    @classmethod
    def close(cls, ptr: int) -> None:
        cls.check(cls.lib().hipIpcCloseMemHandle(ctypes.c_void_p(ptr)), "hipIpcCloseMemHandle")

    @classmethod
    def free(cls, ptr: int) -> None:
        cls.check(cls.lib().hipFree(ctypes.c_void_p(ptr)), "hipFree")


def _all_gather_objects(obj: Any, group: Any) -> list[Any]:
    """``obj`` of every rank of ``group``, in group-rank order (CPU broadcasts)."""
    ranks = dist.get_process_group_ranks(group)
    objs = [[None] for _ in ranks]
    objs[dist.get_rank(group)][0] = obj
    for i, global_rank in enumerate(ranks):
        dist.broadcast_object_list(objs[i], src=global_rank, group=group, device="cpu")
    return [o[0] for o in objs]


class TailGroup:
    """One rank's state of the kernel's group, made by ``setup``: what its launches read and write."""

    def __init__(self, cpu_group: Any, rank: int, world: int, peer_table: torch.Tensor, failed_word: int,
                 hip: Any) -> None:  # fmt: skip
        self.cpu_group, self.rank, self.world, self.hip = cpu_group, rank, world, hip
        self.peer_table = peer_table
        # this rank's group FAILED word, the address a step's check reads (``hip.copy_word``)
        self.failed_word = failed_word
        device = peer_table.device
        self.scratch = torch.zeros(SCRATCH_BYTES, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
        self.counters = torch.zeros(GRID, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        self.health = torch.zeros(HEALTH_WORDS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        # the kernel builds this group launches: its wait timeout (tests shorten it) and which are compiled
        self.wait_seconds = WAIT_SECONDS
        self.warmed: set[Any] = set()


def setup(cpu_group: Any, rank: int, world: int, device: torch.device, hip: Any = Hip) -> TailGroup | None:
    """This rank's group state, made collectively: every rank of ``cpu_group`` (a CPU process group of the ``world``
    ranks, ``rank`` this one's) must call it at the same point. None on every rank when any rank cannot take part
    (a GPU with fewer CUs than workgroups, a failed allocation, export or mapping); an earlier group of the device is
    kept. ``hip`` makes the HIP calls (``Hip``'s).

    The ranks agree after each step that can fail on one rank alone, before any of them goes on to the next
    collective: a rank that skipped one the others entered would leave them waiting in it for ever."""
    device = torch.device(device)
    if device in GROUPS:
        return GROUPS[device]
    failure = None
    try:
        if hip.compute_units(device) < GRID:
            failure = RuntimeError(f"a GPU of fewer than {GRID} CUs")
    except Exception as e:  # every rank must still reach the agreement
        failure = e
    if not _agreed(failure, cpu_group, "the GPU check"):
        return None
    local = handle = None
    try:
        local = hip.alloc_uncached(PEER_BYTES)
        handle = hip.handle(local) if world > 1 else None
    except Exception as e:
        failure = e
    if not _agreed(failure, cpu_group, "allocating or exporting the peer buffer"):
        _release(hip, [], local)
        return None
    handles = _all_gather_objects(handle, cpu_group) if world > 1 else [None]
    opened, group = [], None
    try:
        addresses = []
        for peer, peer_handle in enumerate(handles):
            if peer == rank:
                addresses.append(local)
            else:
                opened.append(hip.open(peer_handle))
                addresses.append(opened[-1])
        table = torch.tensor(addresses, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
        group = TailGroup(cpu_group, rank, world, table, local + GROUP_FAILED, hip)
    except Exception as e:
        failure = e
    if not _agreed(failure, cpu_group, "mapping the peers' buffers"):
        _release(hip, opened, local)
        return None
    GROUPS[device] = group
    return group


def _release(hip: Any, opened: list[int], local: int | None) -> None:
    """Unmap ``opened`` and free ``local`` after the ranks agreed to give up: a failure here is only logged, as no
    rank waits on this one any more."""
    try:
        for base in opened:
            hip.close(base)
        if local:
            hip.free(local)
    except Exception as e:
        _LOGGER.warning("latent-MoE tail: releasing the peer memory failed (%r)", e)


def _agreed(failure: BaseException | None, cpu_group: Any, what: str) -> bool:
    """Whether no rank's ``failure`` is set (every rank calls it at the same point); the warning where one is."""
    if tp_agree(failure is None, cpu_group):
        return True
    _LOGGER.warning("latent-MoE tail: %s failed on %s rank (%r); the kernel is off",
                    what, "this" if failure else "another", failure)  # fmt: skip
    return False


@functools.cache
def default_group(device_index: int) -> TailGroup:
    """The group state of ``cuda:<device_index>`` over torch.distributed's default group, for a first call that no
    caller set a group up for (validation's ranks, a process each in the default group, which calls the kernel's
    Points in the same order on every rank): set up collectively, as ``setup``."""
    device = torch.device("cuda", device_index)
    group = setup(dist.group.WORLD, dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size(), device)
    if group is None:
        raise RuntimeError("latent-MoE tail: the group's peer memory could not be set up")
    return group


@functools.cache
def every_rank_compiled(group: TailGroup, launch: Any) -> None:
    """Every rank of ``group`` past its first launch of ``launch``, the empty one that compiled it: no rank's first
    real launch then waits on another rank's compile (a barrier on the group's CPU group, once a build)."""
    tp_agree(True, group.cpu_group)
